name: Preemnik
source:
An old house. A stormy February night. A dying old man must choose who will be his heir, for not only his life is at stake.

A short chamber story about family issues.

[From [url=https://olivson.itch.io/heir]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一栋老宅。一个风暴肆虐的二月夜晚。一位垂死的老人必须选定继承人，因为命悬一线的，并不只有他自己。

一则场景集中、围绕家庭问题展开的短篇故事。

[摘自[url=https://olivson.itch.io/heir]itch.io[/url]]
